content.short: FIDE AI is an on-chain AI inference protocol on Mantle enabling verifiable, decentralized artificial intelligence computation for Web3 applications.
content.description: FIDE AI is a decentralized AI inference protocol that brings verifiable artificial intelligence computation to blockchain applications. The protocol enables smart contracts and dApps to call AI models on-chain with cryptographic guarantees that the inference was performed correctly, without trusting a centralized provider. FIDE AI is deployed on Mantle and provides Web3 developers with a trustless way to integrate AI capabilities  from content generation to predictive analytics  directly into their decentralized applications.
